trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Senior Fund Administrator (PA26ASADMRQ3001)
Company: SS&C Technologies
About the company: SS&C is a global provider of investment, financial services and software for the financial services and healthcare industries. Named to Fortune 1000 list as top U.S. company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut and has 20,000+ employees in over 90 offices in 35 countries. Some 18,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest institutions to local firms, manage and account for their investments using SS&C's products and services.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Maintain and update investment data with precision, ensuring accuracy and completeness across all platforms.
  - Perform regular data reconciliations to identify and rectify discrepancies.
  - Ensure compliance with data governance and data protection standards.
  - Manage domestic and foreign securities, including trades, settlements, corporate actions, and other related activities.
  - Handle valuations and reporting of investment portfolios, ensuring accurate pricing and performance metrics.
  - Liaise with custodians, brokers, and other counterparties to resolve trade and settlement issues.
  - Support the processing and management of funds, including contributions, redemptions, and related administrative tasks.
  - Assist in the preparation of reports for clients, management, and regulatory bodies.
  - Adhere to relevant regulatory and compliance requirements, ensuring that all data and transactions meet established standards.
  - Mitigate risks associated with data and securities handling through diligent checks and adherence to processes.
  - Identify opportunities for improving the efficiency and accuracy of the fund administration process.
  - Participate in projects aimed at automating and streamlining the function.
  - Foster existing business relationships to ensure effective and efficient delivery, working with compliance, and operations teams to gather necessary data and insights.
  - Liaise with service level suppliers and external vendors.
  - Collaborate with colleagues within the team to share knowledge and best practices.
Must-have requirements:
  - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field.
  - 1-3 years related experience, including but not limited to investment administration, fund accounting, asset management, or a similar financial services role.
  - Experience with data management systems, trade settlements, and securities processing.
  - Good knowledge and understanding of the Financial Markets and Financial instruments.
  - Proficient Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.
  - Analytical Skills: Ability to analyse complex financial data and derive meaningful insights.
  - Attention to Detail: Ensures the highest level of accuracy and quality in accounting and reporting.
  - Time Management: Effectively manages time and prioritizes tasks to meet deadlines.
  - Technical Proficiency: Demonstrates proficiency with accounting software and platforms, strong understanding of investment products, fund structures, and accounting principles.
  - Adaptability: Demonstrates flexibility in handling changing requirements.
  - Effective communication skills: The ability to communicate clearly and concisely to the level of audience.
  - Client Focus: Prioritizes client needs and ensures high levels of client satisfaction.
Nice-to-have:
  - A relevant post-graduate qualification or professional certification (e.g., CFA, CAIA, CISI) is advantageous
  - Good knowledge of HiPortfolio an advantage.
Location: Bellville, South Africa
Team notes: Works with compliance, and operations teams; liaises with custodians, brokers, counterparties, service level suppliers and external vendors.
Application process: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. All offers of employment at SS&C are subject to background verification checks, including 5-year employment history, proof of eligibility to work in hiring location, proof of address, credit check and criminal record check (where permitted by local law).
Employment equity statement: We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and particularly welcome applications from under-represented groups, to enable us to bring a diversity of perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense. SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Senior Fund Administrator

SS&C Technologies

Bellville, South Africa

About us
SS&C is a global provider of investment, financial services and software for the financial services and healthcare industries. Named to the Fortune 1000 list as a top U.S. company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut and has 20,000+ employees in over 90 offices in 35 countries. Some 18,000 financial services and healthcare organisations, from the world's largest institutions to local firms, manage and account for their investments using SS&C's products and services.

About the role
You will keep investment data accurate and complete, process domestic and foreign securities, and help produce valuations and reports for clients, management and regulators. You will work from Bellville, South Africa.

Your team
You work with the compliance and operations teams, and liaise with custodians, brokers, counterparties, service level suppliers and external vendors.

What you'll do
• Maintain and update investment data across all platforms, keeping it accurate and complete
• Run regular data reconciliations, then identify and correct discrepancies
• Manage domestic and foreign securities, including trades, settlements and corporate actions
• Produce valuations and reporting of investment portfolios, with accurate pricing and performance metrics
• Liaise with custodians, brokers and other counterparties to resolve trade and settlement issues
• Support fund processing and management, including contributions, redemptions and related administrative tasks
• Assist in preparing reports for clients, management and regulatory bodies
• Apply data governance, data protection, regulatory and compliance standards to all data and transactions
• Mitigate risks in data and securities handling through diligent checks and adherence to processes
• Identify ways to make fund administration more efficient and accurate, and take part in projects that automate and streamline the function
• Work with compliance and operations teams to gather data and insights, and maintain existing business relationships
• Liaise with service level suppliers and external vendors, and share knowledge and best practices with colleagues in your team

What you need
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field
• 1-3 years' related experience, such as investment administration, fund accounting, asset management or a similar financial services role
• Experience with data management systems, trade settlements and securities processing
• Good knowledge and understanding of financial markets and financial instruments
• Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel
• Proficiency with accounting software and platforms, and a strong understanding of investment products, fund structures and accounting principles

Nice to have
• A relevant post-graduate qualification or professional certification, for example CFA, CAIA or CISI
• Good knowledge of HiPortfolio
• Analytical skills to work through complex financial data and draw meaningful insights
• Attention to detail in accounting and reporting
• Time management, so you can prioritise tasks and meet deadlines
• Flexibility in handling changing requirements
• Clear, concise communication pitched to your audience
• A client focus that puts client needs first

How to apply
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. All offers of employment at SS&C are subject to background verification checks, including 5-year employment history, proof of eligibility to work in hiring location, proof of address, credit check and criminal record check (where permitted by local law).

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and particularly welcome applications from under-represented groups, to enable us to bring a diversity of perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense. SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.
